translations.web: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.
translations.bsb: So Zadok and Abiathar returned the ark of God to Jerusalem and stayed there.
translations.kjv: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried ➔ the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.
